# Media & Text

**Name:** `core/media-text`
**Category:** [media](/docs/reference-guides/core-blocks/category-media.md)
**API Version:** [3](/docs/reference-guides/block-api/block-api-versions/)
**Block Type:** [Hybrid](/docs/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering.md) (static save + server enhancements)

- [`allowedBlocks`](/docs/reference-guides/block-api/block-supports.md#allowedblocks): `true`

## Block Markup

This is a [**hybrid block**](/docs/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering.md). It saves static markup that the server may enhance during rendering.

```html
<!-- wp:media-text {"align":"none","mediaAlt":"","mediaPosition":"left","mediaWidth":50,"isStackedOnMobile":true,"useFeaturedImage":false} -->
<!-- Content... -->
<!-- /wp:media-text -->
```
